card.name: Visit times in monitoring schedules
card.fires_on: Commas or spaces just before the next time point in a list of assessment times, such as '4, 8 and 12 months' or 'at 4 to 8 week intervals'. Also numbers inside such lists.

modes.label: Comma in time list
modes.description: The comma after a number in a list of scheduled test or visit times.

modes.label: Number in list
modes.description: A number within a list of weeks at which assessments were done.
modes.example: hematological and chemistry assessments were at 1, <<3>>, 5, and 8 weeks

card.writes: It suggests the next item is a number of days, weeks or similar time unit, as in time-span words.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a monitoring schedule where the next check-up time, like 4, 8 or 12 weeks, is about to be named.
